title: Sikkim Congress protests appointment of Dushyant Gautam in Gangtok

tea.why: Protesters opposed the appointment of Dushyant Gautam as Sikkim Governor amid unverified allegations linking him to the Ankita Bhandari case.
tea.want: Revoke the appointment of Dushyant Gautam as Governor until the CBI completes its investigation.
tea.changed: Oct 16: The Sikkim Pradesh Congress Committee held a protest demonstration in Gangtok demanding the revocation of the gubernatorial appointment.

summary: The Sikkim Pradesh Congress Committee staged a protest in Gangtok on Friday, objecting to the appointment of senior BJP leader Dushyant Gautam as the state governor. Protest participants and party leaders demanded that the Centre revoke the appointment until the CBI concludes its investigation into the 2022 death of Ankita Bhandari in Uttarakhand. According to reports, opposition voices in the region criticized the decision, and party president Gopal Chettri appealed to the President of India to intervene. The sources do not report any official response from the central government or the newly appointed governor to the Gangtok demonstration.
demands: Revoke Dushyant Gautam's appointment as Sikkim Governor
Wait for CBI completion of the investigation into the Bhandari case before giving gubernatorial responsibilities
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: The Sikkim Pradesh Congress Committee staged a protest in Gangtok demanding the recall of the newly appointed governor.

sources.title: Sikkim’s oppn opposes Dushyant’s appt. as Gov
